item.title: Version 0.18.3
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.18.3

What’s New

  • Adjustable Text Size: A new slider in Preferences > Appearance scales sidebar text from 85% to 150%, applied live across the app.
  • Toggle Dark Mode From the Command Panel: A new command panel entry flips between Light and Dark. Search “dark”, “light”, “theme”, or “appearance” to find it.
  • Open in New Window: Right-click a saved link or folder to open it (or every link inside) in a fresh browser window. The menu item shows which browser will be used.
  • Auto-Tile Windows Shortcut: Record a global keyboard shortcut to flip Auto-Tile Windows on and off without opening preferences.

Improvements

  • Pick Profiles When Importing Bookmarks: Importing from Chrome, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi, or Firefox now offers a profile picker, and each chosen profile becomes its own space.
  • Save Rules Can Target a Folder: Air Traffic Control rules now accept a target folder, so a matching save lands in the right folder inside the right space.
  • Browser Name on Replace Active Tab: The Replace Active Tab right-click action now shows the active browser’s name beside it.

Bug Fixes

  • Dragging a link into another folder now immediately removes it from the source folder, instead of appearing in both until the next refresh.
  • Cut, copy, paste, and select-all work again in the command panel search field.
  • Very long search queries in the command panel no longer hang the search.
